legend: There are n$$$n$$$ players sitting at the card table. Each player has a favorite number. The favorite number of the j$$$j$$$-th player is fj$$$f_j$$$.

There are k⋅n$$$k \cdot n$$$ cards on the table. Each card contains a single integer: the i$$$i$$$-th card contains number ci$$$c_i$$$. Also, you are given a sequence h1,h2,…,hk$$$h_1, h_2, \dots, h_k$$$. Its meaning will be explained below.

The players have to distribute all the cards in such a way that each of them will hold exactly k$$$k$$$ cards. After all the cards are distributed, each player counts the number of cards he has that contains his favorite number. The joy level of a player equals ht$$$h_t$$$ if the player holds t$$$t$$$ cards containing his favorite number. If a player gets no cards with his favorite number (i.e., t=0$$$t=0$$$), his joy level is 0$$$0$$$.
Print the maximum possible total joy levels of the players after the cards are distributed. Note that the sequence h1,…,hk$$$h_1, \dots, h_k$$$ is the same for all the players.
input: The first line of input contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (1≤n≤500,1≤k≤10$$$1 \le n \le 500, 1 \le k \le 10$$$) — the number of players and the number of cards each player will get.
The second line contains k⋅n$$$k \cdot n$$$ integers c1,c2,…,ck⋅n$$$c_1, c_2, \dots, c_{k \cdot n}$$$ (1≤ci≤105$$$1 \le c_i \le 10^5$$$) — the numbers written on the cards.
The third line contains n$$$n$$$ integers f1,f2,…,fn$$$f_1, f_2, \dots, f_n$$$ (1≤fj≤105$$$1 \le f_j \le 10^5$$$) — the favorite numbers of the players.

The fourth line contains k$$$k$$$ integers h1,h2,…,hk$$$h_1, h_2, \dots, h_k$$$ (1≤ht≤105$$$1 \le h_t \le 10^5$$$), where ht$$$h_t$$$ is the joy level of a player if he gets exactly t$$$t$$$ cards with his favorite number written on them. It is guaranteed that the condition ht−1<ht$$$h_{t - 1}  \lt  h_t$$$ holds for each t∈[2..k]$$$t \in [2..k]$$$.
output: Print one integer — the maximum possible total joy levels of the players among all possible card distributions.

legend.ai: 有 n$$$n$$$ 名玩家坐在牌桌旁。每名玩家都有一个喜欢的数字。第 j$$$j$$$ 名玩家喜欢的数字是 fj$$$f_j$$$。
桌上有 k⋅n$$$k \cdot n$$$ 张卡片。每张卡片上写着一个整数：第 i$$$i$$$ 张卡片上写着数字 ci$$$c_i$$$。此外，给定一个序列 h1,h2,…,hk$$$h_1, h_2, \dots, h_k$$$。其含义将在下文解释。
玩家需要以一种方式分配所有卡片，使得每位玩家恰好拿到 k$$$k$$$ 张卡片。所有卡片分配完毕后，每位玩家统计自己拿到的卡片中写有其最喜欢数字的卡片数量。如果一名玩家拿到了 t$$$t$$$ 张写有其最喜欢数字的卡片，那么该玩家的快乐值为 ht$$$h_t$$$。如果一名玩家没有拿到写有其最喜欢数字的卡片(即 t=0$$$t=0$$$)，那么其快乐值为 0$$$0$$$。
输出分配卡片后所有玩家快乐值之和的最大可能值。注意，序列 h1,…,hk$$$h_1, \dots, h_k$$$ 对所有玩家都相同。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$(1≤n≤500，1≤k≤10$$$1 \le n \le 500, 1 \le k \le 10$$$)，分别表示玩家数量以及每位玩家将拿到的卡片数量。
第二行包含 k⋅n$$$k \cdot n$$$ 个整数 c1,c2,…,ck⋅n$$$c_1, c_2, \dots, c_{k \cdot n}$$$(1≤ci≤105$$$1 \le c_i \le 10^5$$$)，表示卡片上写的数字。
第三行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 f1,f2,…,fn$$$f_1, f_2, \dots, f_n$$$(1≤fj≤105$$$1 \le f_j \le 10^5$$$)，表示各位玩家最喜欢的数字。

第四行包含 k$$$k$$$ 个整数 h1,h2,…,hk$$$h_1, h_2, \dots, h_k$$$(1≤ht≤105$$$1 \le h_t \le 10^5$$$)，其中 ht$$$h_t$$$ 表示一名玩家恰好获得 t$$$t$$$ 张写有其喜爱数字的卡片时的快乐值。保证对于每个 t∈[2..k]$$$t \in [2..k]$$$，均满足条件 ht−1<ht$$$h_{t - 1}  \lt  h_t$$$。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——在所有可能的卡片分配方案中，玩家快乐值总和的最大可能值。
